column1: # Abzu service table - the rc.conf.local equivalent for Darwin.
# THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Both consumers read it:
# userland/etc/sandbox.d/gen-profiles.sh uses column 4 to emit the profiles that
# the generated plists reference -- closing the dangling-path defect recorded in
#   1 tool            portmap tool name (must exist in import/portmap.tsv unless
#   3 state           on | off | blocked   (blocked = never started, never installed)
#   4 profile         seatbelt profile path in the image ('' when blocked)
#   5 user            privilege-drop user (must exist in etc/master.passwd)
#   6 phase           boot ordering hint consumed by abzu-init
